search_text: published ZDI-22-522 ZDI-CAN-15762 (Pwn2Own) NETGEAR R6700v3 readycloud_control.cgi Authentication Bypass Vulnerability 2022-03-23 CVE-2022-27645 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-27645 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['NETGEAR'] ['R6700v3'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700v3 routers. title: (Pwn2Own) NETGEAR R6700v3 readycloud_control.cgi Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of NETGEAR R6700v3 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within readycloud_control.cgi. The issue results from the lack of authentication prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
